name: VTK-Based Transfer Function Application
aliases: Medical-Style Lookup Table & Piecewise Function Definition
definition: A method for applying color and opacity transfer functions using VTK classes (`vtkLookupTable` and `vtkPiecewiseFunction`) to map scalar values to RGBA components.
summary: VTK-Based Transfer Function Application uses vtkLookupTable and vtkPiecewiseFunction for color and opacity mapping, differing from splines by relying on VTK's internal lookup table generation.
